title: Cohomology of abelian sheaves on a topological space
statement: For a topological space X, let H^p(X,F) for an abelian sheaf F be the p-th right derived functor [def-sp-left-exact-additive] of Gamma(X,-) on the abelian category of sheaves of abelian groups on X, which has enough injectives [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaves-enough-injectives] (applied to the site of open subsets of X with open coverings). Every short exact sequence of abelian sheaves induces a natural long exact cohomology sequence [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-universal-delta-functor]. For a scheme X with its small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site], this is H^p(X_{\rm Zar},F) of [def-sc-zariski-cohomology].
